name: qa-realtime-protocols
description: Real-time protocol testing: WebSocket handshakes and close codes, Server-Sent Events, and MQTT v5 QoS, retained messages and shared subscriptions. Includes SSE load testing with k6 and STOMP / AMQP broker testing in references. A review agent (realtime-protocol-reviewer) flags missing reconnect backoff and unhandled close codes. gRPC streaming lives in qa-grpc and webhooks in qa-notifications.
